grant.hemana: Pavel Hemana was a clockmaker in Dunmarrow until the posters went up. He came to R-S14 with a lock of hair in a matchbox, and within a day the whole squad knew that he writes everything down in a tiny notebook.
Pavel Hemana cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.
hi691812: Bastian "Mud" Hi took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
lynallwarrior51: The draft reached S-S3 on Day 8. Karel Lynallwarrio was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
Karel Lynallwarrio cut Marek "Lucky" Chase's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
totally_geeked_fish: At the depot, Matthias "Brick" Fish had practised answering to his name. At S-C16, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
totally_normal_ozzy: The sergeant gave Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 8 or any other.
Norbert "Shadow" Peakharmon and Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
